title: Volunteer Metric0 Rolling 7-Day Value Average
dataSources: Volunteer shifts (`volunteer:shift`), donations (`donation:gift`), community events (`community:event`), mutual-aid requests (`mutualaid:request`), impact metrics (`impact:metric`).
app: Volunteering and community telemetry — volunteer-hours trackers, donation receipts, mutual-aid request boards, and community-event calendars — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=volunteer:metric0 value=*
| bin _time span=1d
| stats avg(value) as daily_avg by _time
| streamstats window=7 avg(daily_avg) as rolling_7d
| sort _time
description: Tracks a seven-day rolling average of daily value for volunteer metric0 data.
value: Rolling averages highlight gradual drift without overreacting to one-off days.
implementation: Compute daily average `value` then a seven-day rolling mean for volunteer metric0 events.
visualization: Line chart of daily and rolling average value.
grandmaExplanation: It works out the smoothed week-long trend in your value from volunteer metric0.
